opening.argument: The video’s primary purpose is to teach educators how to organize and conduct remote lessons in Microsoft Teams. It explains how to invite students to a live lesson and share presentations, including PowerPoint materials, while the title identifies the subject as online lessons for remote learning. The interaction shown is a Microsoft Forms feedback survey, with a questionnaire focused on joining and using the remote lesson. Ordinary creator-support and affiliate links are also described, but they are separate from the educational demonstration and are not shown to involve deceptive conduct.

citations.quote: I'll be showing you how to invite your students to a live remote lesson hosted in Teams, how to share a presentation with your students.
I've made a survey in Microsoft. Forms.
